purpose: Stores original image uploads/replacements, publishes originals to S3-compatible object storage when enabled, and returns object-storage metadata for DB persistence.
businessRules: Only non-empty image uploads are accepted.
Original images are stored under versioned asset paths separate from generated variants.
Asset keys are slugged from original filenames and suffixed for uniqueness.
Replacement uploads preserve the asset key and write a new vN object path.
SHA-256, byte size, dimensions, content type, object key, storage provider, delivery mode, and version are captured for each original.
futureIntegration: Local storage root is the image-processing work area; generated objects are published to the configured S3-compatible object store.
StorefrontMediaUrlBuilder maps object keys to the configured S3-compatible public media base URL.
